result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The page mostly looks fine, but a couple of content cards are clipped by the viewport, making the layout feel slightly broken.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its content is obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so cards never render underneath the persistent nav bar.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the "Fastest near you" horizontal row is cut off at the edge of the screen, with the image and title partially visible.
issues.suggestion: If this is meant to be a carousel, make the clipping/peek more intentional; otherwise adjust spacing or card width so the item is fully visible.
